## 73500a0803e5

**Reproduced semantic coverage defect.** Generator SHA-256
`536dd2c5b3b55a7d1c69d0208c71fbe26686d0617667b221935fca98b4f3137c` excludes
color 8 from every body-cell draw even though canonical examples use cyan as
ordinary body data. A 900-input source-bound scan (300 per band) found zero body
color-8 cells in all 900 accepted grids: `checks/audit/73500a0803e5/scan.json`.

The retained 3x4 witness has two cyan header markers and a selected body cyan:
`checks/audit/73500a0803e5/input.json`. The target's `self_check` returns `[]`.
The canonical Racket authority (rule hash `e82c0cb74706`) returns
`[[8,3],[5,7]]`; the plausible rival “extract marked columns but zero any body
cyan because cyan is marker-only” returns `[[0,3],[5,7]]`. Full hashes, command,
input, outputs, and domain note are in
`checks/audit/73500a0803e5/counterexample.json`; the supported apply receipt is
`checks/audit/73500a0803e5/racket.json`.

The witness is outside the generator's own stated “non-8 body” restriction but
inside the canonical task domain, which is the defect: the restriction teaches a
wrong color-role shortcut. No source was changed for this audit target.
